assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: finished raster poster for the Beat my track challenge menu. Restyle the FIRST input image, keeping its exact camera, framing, composition, subject count, object placement, proportions and scene identity. The SECOND input is ONLY a cel-shading technique reference: matte colour planes, stepped light, selective contours. Do not copy its vehicle, branding or scene. Strong mature CEL-SHADED 3D game render, visibly non-photorealistic: fully dimensional believable geometry rendered with two or three broad discrete lighting bands per material, crisp deliberate light/shadow boundaries, large clean planar shapes and selective thin dark silhouette/structural outlines. Broad flat satin paint highlights; dark glass in large simple planes. Simplify fine surface detail and background shapes. Flat matte asphalt/concrete, clean readable contact shadows, unified natural navy, stone, ivory and subdued warm hues drawn from the original image. Restrained natural colour. Remove photographic/PBR reflections, continuous glossy gradients, asphalt grain, microtexture, noisy foliage, scratches, ray-traced lighting, bloom, lens effects and depth-of-field blur. This must read like a carefully authored 3D toon-shader screenshot, not a photoreal render with an edge filter, painterly illustration, 2D vector poster, low-poly toy, plastic car or comic halftone. Keep every object mechanically coherent, with no added objects or decoration, logos, labels, readable text, numbers or watermark. Style change only. Specific edit target: the portrait 2:3 duel image with EXACTLY TWO fictional boxy rally hatchbacks facing forward in two separate parallel grid boxes, ivory/navy car on left and red/ivory car on right, same scale, four round front lamps each, helmeted drivers on their own left-hand-drive side. Preserve the checkered start strip and the calm navy dusk pit lane with lit windows and two floodlight towers. Keep the bottom asphalt quiet for a native UI caption. Match the original 1024x1536 portrait ratio.
